items.name: bedrock-configuration
items.summary: Configure Claude Code to use Amazon Bedrock for AI model access. Enables enterprise-grade deployment with AWS billing and compliance features, ideal for organizations already using AWS infrastructure.

items.name: corporate-proxy
items.summary: Configure proxy settings for corporate network environments. Allows Claude Code to work behind corporate firewalls and proxy servers while maintaining security compliance with enterprise network policies.

items.name: custom-headers
items.summary: Add custom headers to API requests for specialized authentication or routing requirements. Useful for enterprise deployments with custom authentication systems or API gateways that require additional metadata.

items.name: vertex-configuration
items.summary: Connect Claude Code with Google Vertex AI to access Anthropic's Claude models through Google Cloud Platform. Automatically configures all available Claude models (Sonnet, Haiku, Opus) with enterprise-grade infrastructure, billing, and security. Requires: GCP project with Vertex AI API enabled…

items.name: api-key-helper
items.summary: Configure a custom script to dynamically generate authentication tokens. The script will be executed to obtain fresh API keys, useful for environments with rotating credentials or temporary access tokens. TTL is set to 1 hour (3600000ms).

items.name: force-claudeai-login
items.summary: Restrict authentication to Claude.ai accounts only. This prevents users from logging in with Anthropic Console accounts, ensuring all access goes through the Claude.ai platform for consistent user experience and billing.

items.name: force-console-login
items.summary: Restrict authentication to Anthropic Console accounts only. This ensures all usage is billed through the API billing system and prevents access via Claude.ai accounts, ideal for enterprise environments with centralized billing.

items.name: retention-7-days
items.summary: Set chat transcript retention to 7 days for privacy.

items.name: retention-90-days
items.summary: Set chat transcript retention to 90 days for extended history.

items.name: bash-timeouts
items.summary: Configure timeout settings for bash command execution. Prevents long-running commands from hanging indefinitely while allowing sufficient time for complex operations like builds and deployments.

items.name: development-utils
items.summary: Enhanced development environment configuration with useful utilities and debugging features. Includes built-in ripgrep usage, terminal title updates, and directory maintenance for improved developer experience.

items.name: friday-deploy-warning
items.summary: Replaces the default spinner verbs with a humorous 'Don't Deploy On Fridays' reminder. Every time Claude is thinking, the spinner will display this message as a lighthearted warning against risky end-of-week deployments.

items.name: idle-compaction-early
items.summary: Start idle compaction at 100K tokens instead of 200K (Claude Code 2.1.290+). A terminal conversation left idle for about 54 minutes is compacted before its one-hour prompt cache expires, so the next message does not reprocess it all. 100K is the lowest value Claude Code accepts. Idle compaction…

items.name: idle-compaction-off
items.summary: Turn off idle compaction (Claude Code 2.1.290+). By default, a terminal conversation over 200K tokens (CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS) that sits idle for about 54 minutes is compacted before its one-hour prompt cache expires; this only happens with auto-compact on and the one-hour cache in…

items.name: performance-optimization
items.summary: Optimize Claude Code performance by adjusting token limits and disabling non-essential features. Reduces API costs and improves response times for development workflows focused on code quality over conversational features.

items.name: privacy-focused
items.summary: Maximize privacy by disabling all telemetry, error reporting, and non-essential network traffic. Ideal for sensitive development environments or organizations with strict data privacy requirements.

items.name: aws-credentials
items.summary: Configure AWS credential management for Bedrock integration. Set up custom scripts for credential refresh and export, useful for environments with rotating AWS credentials or SSO integration.

items.name: company-announcements
items.summary: Display custom company announcements in Claude Code. Replace the example messages in the 'companyAnnouncements' array with your own organization's announcements, guidelines, or reminders.

items.name: concise-mode
items.summary: Make Claude Code as concise as possible: sets the Concise output style so responses lead with results and skip preamble, and turns off non-essential chat noise (spinner tips, away recap, verbose output). Ideal for experienced users who want minimal terminal output.

items.name: custom-model
items.summary: Override the default Claude model with a custom or alternative model configuration. Useful for testing new model versions or using organization-specific model deployments.

items.name: git-commit-settings
items.summary: Configure git commit behavior including the co-authored-by signature. Disable the Claude co-authorship line if you prefer clean commit history or have organizational policies against AI attribution.

items.name: spinner-tips-override
items.summary: Customize the spinner tips shown while Claude is thinking. Replace the example tip string in the 'tips' array with your own custom messages. Set 'excludeDefault: true' to show only your custom tips, or 'false' to mix them with the built-in ones.

items.name: disable-risky-servers
items.summary: Disable specific MCP servers that may pose security risks or are not needed for your workflow. This blacklist approach allows most servers while blocking potentially problematic integrations.

items.name: enable-all-project-servers
items.summary: Automatically approve and enable all MCP servers defined in project .mcp.json files. This setting bypasses manual approval prompts for project-defined MCP servers, streamlining development workflow in trusted environments.

items.name: enable-specific-servers
items.summary: Enable only specific MCP servers from .mcp.json files. This provides granular control over which MCP integrations are active, allowing you to selectively enable trusted or required servers while blocking others.

items.name: mcp-timeouts
items.summary: Configure timeout settings for MCP server operations. Adjust startup and tool execution timeouts to accommodate slower systems or complex MCP server operations while preventing indefinite hangs.

items.name: read-only-mode
